verdicts.originalText: Tamoto's interval slashes (Chiori's main off-field damage source) carry both ATK and DEF scaling in-game — the timeline renders the per-tick markers (P3) using the ATK component only (147.74% ATK at TalentLvl 10); the DEF-scaling FlatDmg layer (turretDefScaling) isn't rendered. Tap E frames are canonical; Hold E (aim mode, longer cast) is not authored as a separate variant.
verdicts.proposedText: The off-field ticks scale off both ATK and DEF in game, but only the ATK component is modeled. Hold E (aim mode, longer cast) isn't modeled separately, so tap-E timing is always used.
verdicts.rationale: Not entirely curator-facing: it flags a real shown-vs-in-game divergence (ticks scale off both ATK and DEF, only ATK authored) plus a genuine omission (no Hold-E variant, so tap timing is used regardless). Both are user-relevant, so ambiguity downgrades to rewrite rather than delete. Dropped the internal field names (turretDefScaling, FlatDmg), the render-phase tag (P3), the precise scaling number, and frame-source language — all already captured in _curatorNotes. [Adjudicated per wave-3 verifier downgrade.]

claimsLost.claim: these interval slashes are Chiori's main off-field damage source
the ATK component is exactly 147.74% ATK at talent level 10
the omitted DEF portion is a flat-damage layer (turretDefScaling)
the ticks render as per-tick (P3) markers

demotedNotes: Precise off-field-tick scaling (ATK 147.74% at talent 10) and the omitted DEF-scaling flat-damage layer (turretDefScaling) are already documented in the summon-migration curator note above; the schema's damage Effect carries one scaling only, which is why the DEF component is unauthored.

verdicts.originalText: The +20% Geo DMG Bonus fires when ANY party member creates a Geo Construct (e.g. Noelle shield, Zhongli pillar, Albedo flower, Geo Traveler walls, Chiori's own Tamoto). The planner doesn't track teammate construct spawns, so this buff is authored as a manual-trigger window — toggle it on when applicable.
verdicts.proposedText: Fires whenever any party member creates a Geo Construct (including Tamoto). Construct spawns aren't tracked, so this is a manual toggle — turn it on when one is up.
verdicts.rationale: Legitimate CANNOT-model note: there is no construct-spawn trigger primitive (curator notes confirm it would need a new onConstructSpawned type), so the buff is authored as a user-toggled manual window — a valid instruction to keep. Reworded to 'the timeline' voice per style rule 7 (dropped 'the planner doesn't'), trimmed the long teammate-construct example list to one representative case, and let the buff window carry the +20%/20s magnitude.
